maturity_levels.implemented: Implemented and working: tested, checked and released or ready to release.
maturity_levels.implemented_not_validated: Implemented, but its methods are not yet validated against reference data.
maturity_levels.prototype: Works for documented cases; interfaces may still change.

domains.name: Science of science
domains.question: How is research produced, evaluated and recognised?

domains.name: Research integrity and governance
domains.question: Is research done, disclosed and communicated responsibly?

domains.name: Reproducibility and research quality
domains.question: Can research outputs be checked and reproduced?

domains.name: Shared infrastructure
domains.question: What keeps the tools consistent and maintained?

components.name: OpenResearchMetrics
components.role: Open science indicators for responsible research assessment; each indicator stands alone, with its evidence and limits, and there is no composite score.
components.notes: The web tool (JavaScript) is the reference implementation. The R package in r/ mirrors its engine and is checked against the same recorded responses and expected report.

components.name: Narrative CV Crosswalk
components.role: Maps narrative CV sections (R4RI, Spanish CVA) to the evidence held by ORCID, OpenAlex, DataCite and OpenAIRE, and shows what only the researcher can tell.
components.notes: Submitted to CRAN; frozen until CRAN decides. Integrated by reference only.

components.name: academiccareer
components.role: Descriptive, evidence-based profiles of academic careers: timelines, contributions and transitions across outputs, software, data, teaching, transfer and service. No ranking or scores.
components.notes: Complements narrativecv: narrativecv maps evidence to CV frameworks, academiccareer describes the career over time.

components.name: aitrail
components.role: Documents, verifies and discloses the use of AI in research: AI-use log by project phase, human verification, audit of oversight gaps, reference checks and disclosure statements.
components.notes: Covers declared and verified AI use by a research team. Analysis of AI policies and disclosures across publications is planned as a separate component.

components.name: scicomm
components.role: Assesses fidelity and audience fit in science communication: each version of a finding for specialists, students and the public is checked against the evidence, with clarity, accessibility and uncertainty indicators in English and Spanish.
components.notes: Fills the scientific communication evaluation component; no new package is needed.

components.name: ReproImage
components.role: Integrity, provenance and reproducibility checks for scientific images: identical files, identical pixels and visually similar images in eight orientations, with RO-Crate provenance.
components.notes: Provides the image-integrity signals that the planned forensic scientometrics component will consume; it is not duplicated there.

components.name: REPRO2IMPACT
components.role: Research project on reproducibility indicators and their association with academic and social impact: transparency detectors, protocol, preregistration and pipeline.
components.notes: Its versioned transparency detectors are the seed of the planned research reproducibility package.

components.name: research-tools-ops
components.role: Reusable GitHub Actions workflows: weekly CRAN check watch, monthly automatic releases and Zenodo DOIs; scientific changes always wait for review.
components.notes: The maintenance layer of the ecosystem; extended rather than replaced.

components.name: metascience
components.role: This catalogue and the shared foundation: identifiers, status vocabulary, evidence levels and provenance manifests.

components.name: forsci
components.role: Forensic scientometrics, with a paper mills module: publication, citation, authorship and affiliation anomaly signals, evidence management and reproducible case reports. A signal is never an accusation.
components.notes: Five signals, paper mill screen, Retraction Watch linking, cases and reports. Validated on a simulated benchmark only. Image signals come from reproimage.

components.name: researchreproducibility
components.role: Reproducibility audits of research projects and articles: data and code availability, environment and dependency reporting, provenance and checklists.
components.notes: Project audit (14-item checklist with references), template and GitHub Action; article detectors ported unchanged from repro2impact (version 1.1.0).

components.name: Metascience benchmarks
components.role: Synthetic and public benchmark cases with known outcomes for validating the methods of the ecosystem.
components.notes: Starts inside each package's tests (recorded responses, reference images); moved to its own repository only when shared cases appear.
